pages.title: CURIO CLOSET
lines: A pair of gloved hands unfolds from the dark. What catches your eye?

pages.title: FINALIZE TRADE
lines: Are you sure you want to buy

pages.title: A FAIR EXCHANGE
lines: Purchased {item}! The hand places it carefully in your inventory.

pages.title: NO DEAL
lines: Not enough Emeralds. The hand refuses the trade.

pages.title: NO DEAL
lines: The hand withdraws. Nothing changes hands.

pages.title: A QUIET WORD
lines: The hands move with practiced care. Every object here belonged to a traveler who stopped listening to the road.

pages.title: A QUIET WORD
lines: Beyond town, the old path has begun returning things that were never lost. Keep your team close if you follow it.

pages.title: UNTIL NEXT TIME
lines: The fingers fold back into the closet. Return when something calls to you.
